mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent price pressures that trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing immediate equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp is not associated with negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1.2 million units during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE declines by at least 0.2 percentage points over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signal manufacturing contraction that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO remains below 100.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate increases above 5.0% signal aggressive policy that raises borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% during a tightening cycle.
